body:
I think we need Rolldown to support https://rollupjs.org/configuration-options/#output-generatedcode-symbols from Rollup (or just set `Symbol.toStringTag]: "Module"`

https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/0b13a9490dfd65c332e90411239024468202b012/code/core/src/preview-api/modules/preview-web/docs-context/DocsContext.ts#L160

relies on modules having `[Symbol.toStringTag]: "Module"` defined, which Rollup does, Rolldown doesn't

It's on the backlog: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/206

Yes. You are right. We might need to transform it to es5. I'm thinking use https://rollupjs.org/configuration-options/#output-generatedcode to control this behavior. Let's create an issue for discussions and not touch the runtime module currently.
